notes.title: Release update from March 9th, 2023:
notes.content:
[h1]New:[/h1]

[h3]Newly added language: Chinese.[/h3]

[h3]Before starting a new game, select a level of difficulty.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42334950/65c8c0aa5cbcf5a225aa777aaeba891e39394907.png[/img]

[h3]You can now also change the rendering mode and enable Raytracing.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42334950/d84d0703ae188f4f51bafb187c067bf9cff94864.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42334950/cd7e885e04dc684241b37a80ba2380dd9d5f97aa.png[/img]

[h3]You can also display the tutorial for the next new or existing game.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42334950/420cda56c4a062d95e9881655ead023ae15adce4.png[/img]

[h3]In the settings there are two new functions to show or hide the position of the upcoming natural disaster and the weather. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42334950/bf00a120f28d0214681e63fae2d9c9801e013f11.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42334950/02133e3d2fc21f9b1b623739c62c83359b2f3ded.png[/img]

[h3]With this update, two new elements for the skyscrapers come into play: a garden element for the square skyscrapers and a garden element for the round skyscrapers. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42334950/f73062ff973d1b5c34808d960ce26974e3795e57.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42334950/6cb9fba757bd04e8cc2063c235d9f523a3915481.png[/img]

[h3]If you are in a round, you can view the individual areas in which the respective natural disasters may occur.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42334950/ef54899cd75ae320719a52660a6512dd15f5c350.png[/img]

[h3]The player is also shown the next building element in the bottom right corner.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42334950/7952879f6cf15ab435be53b686f7e7dac2b66ce7.png[/img]

[h1]Improvement:[/h1]

[h3]If you are in the pause menu, the camera will no longer be moved.[/h3]

[h3]In the upcoming update you can undo the last placed item.[/h3]
